paite: Huan Pathian in Noah leh long sung a akiang a thil hing chiteng leh ganta om tengteng atheigige a; Pathian in leitung ah huih anungsak a, tui ahong dai panta hi.
heading: Tuichim Tawpna
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

paite: Tui thukpi nakte leh van tohlette hong kikhakta ua, van a kipan vuah leng theusak ahita.
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

paite: Lei a kipan tui akiam giaigiai a; ni za-le-sawmnga nung in tui hong tawm deuhta a,
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

paite: akha sagihna ani sawm-le-sagih ni in Ararat tang ah long ahong kinga hi.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

paite: Akha sawmna tan in tui akiam giaigiai zel a; akha sawmna ani khat ni in mualvumte akimuta hi.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

paite: Ni sawmli nung in hichi ahong hi a, Noah in abawl long tohlet ahongta hi.
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

paite: Va-ak khat akhahkhia a, leitung a kipan tui akan khit masiah huai va-ak avial lenlen hi.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

paite: Leitung ah tui atawmta hia, tawm nai lou, chih theihna ding in vakhu khat akhahkhe nawn hi.
english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

paite: Himahleh vakhu in tukna ding himhim amu kei a, akiang ah long ah akik nawn a; tui lah leitung pumpi ah a-om lai ngal a. Polam ah akhut agolhkhia a, long sung ah akiang ah ana lalut nawn hi.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

paite: Ni sagih dang angak lai a; long a kipan vakhu akhahkhe nawn hi.
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

paite: Nitaklam in akiang ah vakhu ahong lut nawn a; ngai in, amuk in olive nah khat ahon tuah hi. Noah in leitung ah tui atawmta chih atheita hi.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

paite: Ni sagih dang angak nawn a; vakhu akhahkhe nawn a; akiang ah hong kik nawn kei hi.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum zaguk-le-khatna, akha khatna, ani khat ni in, leitung a kipan tui akangta hi. Noah in long khuhna akoihsuan a, a-en a; ngai in, leitung ahulta hi.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

paite: Akha nihna ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in leitung ahulta hi.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang ah thu agen a;
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

paite: "Long a kipan nang pawt inla, na zi leh na tapate leh na tapate zite leng na kiang ah pawt uhen.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

paite: Sa tengteng lak a thil hing chiteng na ompihte, vasate, gante, leitung a bokvak a pai ganhing chitengte toh na kiang ah pikhia in, leitung a chiphatak a chi tampi suang a ahong puntheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

paite: Noah apawt a, atapate leh azi leh atapate zite leng akiang ah apawt uhi.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

paite: Sa chiteng, ganhing chiteng, vasa chiteng, leitung a tang thei peuhmahte amau chi omdan dungzui zel in long a kipan apawtta uhi.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

paite: Noah in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; sa siang chiteng lak leh vasa siang chiteng lak a kipan ala a, maitam ah halmang pumpiaknate alanta hi.
heading: Noah Kithoihna
english: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

paite: TOUPA'N huai gim namtui aza a; TOUPA'N alungsim in, "Mite ziak in leitung ka hamsiat nawn kei ding, mite lungsim ngaihtuahnate lah tuailai ahih a kipan gilou ahi ngal ua. Tua ka gawt bang in thil hing chiteng leng ka gawt nawn kei ding.
english: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

paite: "Leitung a-om lai teng buhtuh leh buhlakte, khovot leh kholumte, nipi leh phalbite, sun leh zante abei kei ding," achi hi.
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
